The mass of an object is measured on Earth. The mass is 5.0kg.
The object is taken to the Moon. The mass of the object is measured on the Moon.
What is the mass of the object on the Moon?
A
0kg
B
more than 0kg, but less than 5.0kg
C
5.0kg
D
more than 5.0kg
subject: Physics
